topic: Getting a Document Notarized at the Bank

script.title: SIGN IT HERE
script.story_hook: One signature, one stamp, and a small scare.
script.intro_zh: 一個簽名、一顆印章，外加一場小虛驚。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's bank errand. Listen for rules about signing and ID.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的銀行跑腿任務。請留意簽名與證明的相關規則。
script.outro: And that's a document notarized on time. Remember, the signature happens in person.
script.outro_zh: 一份文件就這樣準時完成公證。記住，簽名一定要當場進行。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her early twenties with long straight black hair in a low braid, round wire glasses, a beige trench coat over a gray sweater, a canvas shoulder bag, and a petite build
script.char_b_description: a tall older man in his sixties with short white hair combed to the side, thick rectangular glasses, a navy bank vest over a light blue shirt with a striped tie, clean-shaven, and a tidy thin build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, where can I find a notary?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ wɛɹ kæn aɪ faɪnd ə ˈnoʊtəˌrɛɹi/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，請問公證要在哪裡辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's me, at window two, after this line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts mi æt ˈwɪndoʊ tu ˈæftɚ ðɪs laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 就是我，輪完這隊就到二號窗口找你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, thank goodness. Is it busy today?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs ɪz ɪt ˈbizi təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝天謝地。今天人多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, it's payday, everyone deposits checks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪɾəl ɪts ˈpeɪˌdeɪ ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn dɪˈpɑzəts tʃɛks/
dialogue.zh: 有一點多，今天是發薪日，大家都來存支票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know. Do I need an appointment?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tə noʊ du aɪ nid əˈpɔɪntmənt/
dialogue.zh: 了解。需要提前預約嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not for one signature, just grab a seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt fɚ wʌn ˈsɪɡnətʃɚ dʒʌst ɡɹæb ə sit/
dialogue.zh: 只簽一個名不用預約，請先坐一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, it's a trip form for my brother.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪts ə tɹɪp fɔɹm fɚ maɪ ˈbrʌðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 是弟弟畢業旅行要簽的文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, and who's signing the form?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ænd huz ˈsaɪnɪŋ ðə fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 好，誰要在表格上簽名？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mom, she's the guardian on paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ mɑm ʃiːz ðə ˈɡɑɹdiən ɑn ˈpeɪpɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽，文件上的監護人是她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Did she sign it already?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt dɪd ʃi saɪn ɪt ɔˈlɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 明白了。她已經先簽好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, she signed it at home, did I ruin it?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ʃi saɪnd ɪt æt hoʊm dɪd aɪ ˈɹu.ɪn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 等等，她在家就簽了，我是不是搞砸了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No panic, the page is still usable.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpænɪk ðə peɪdʒ ɪz stɪl ˈjuzəbl/
dialogue.zh: 先別慌，這一頁還用得上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? I felt sick for a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹiɚli aɪ fɛlt sɪk fɚ ə ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我那一下心都涼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's the rule: she signs it in front of me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz ðə ˈɹul ʃi saɪnz ɪt ɪn ˈfɹʌnt əv mi/
dialogue.zh: 規矩是：她得當著我的面簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the signature has to happen here.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðə ˈsɪɡnətʃɚ həz tə ˈhæpən hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，簽名非得在現場完成不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, that's the whole job of a notary.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðæts ðə hoʊl dʒɑb əv ə ˈnoʊtəˌrɛɹi/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，這就是公證人的全部工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, she's right outside, should I grab her?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ʃiːz ɹaɪt ˈaʊtsaɪd ʃʊd aɪ ɡɹæb hɚ/
dialogue.zh: 她就在外面，要我去叫她嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the signer must appear in person.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈsaɪnɚ məst əˈpɪɹ ɪn ˈpɝsən/
dialogue.zh: 對，簽名的本人一定要親自到場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back in two minutes, she's super close.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ɪn tu ˈmɪnəts ʃiːz ˈsuːpɚ kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 她就在附近，兩分鐘回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, this line's not moving anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔɹ taɪm ðɪs laɪnz nɑt ˈmuvɪŋ ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不急，反正這條隊也沒在動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, true. Also, um, what ID do we need?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ tru ˈɔlsoʊ ʌm wʌt aɪˈdi du wi nid/
dialogue.zh: 哈，真的。還有，嗯，需要什麼證件？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A current photo ID, that's the main one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkɝɚənt ˈfoʊoʊ aɪˈdi ðæts ðə meɪn wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 效期內附照片的身份證明，那個最要緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She has her state license, we're good then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi hæz hɚ steɪt ˈlaɪsəns wɪɹ ɡʊd ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 她有州駕照，那就齊全了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, and the name must match exactly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ænd ðə neɪm məst mætʃ ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 很好，而且簽的名字要跟證件完全一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Match how? Like, if she changed her name?
dialogue.phonetic: /mætʃ ˈhaʊ laɪk ɪf ʃi ˈtʃeɪndʒd hɚ ˈneɪm/
dialogue.zh: 一致是指什麼？假如她換過姓呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The form has her current name, so she's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɔɹm hæz hɚ ˈkɝɚənt neɪm soʊ ʃiːz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 表格上寫的就是她現在的名字，那沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, and does the school need copies?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ænd dʌz ðə skul nid ˈkɑpiz/
dialogue.zh: 好，那學校需要影本嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll stamp each page, you keep the original.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl stæmp itʃ peɪdʒ ju kip ði əˈɹɪdʒənəl/
dialogue.zh: 我會每頁都蓋章，你們留正本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stamps on every page? That's kind of cool.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæmps ɑn ˈɛvɹi peɪdʒ ðæts kaɪnd əv kul/
dialogue.zh: 每一頁都要蓋章？感覺有點酷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The seal stops people swapping pages later.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sil stɑps ˈpipəl ˈswæpɪŋ ˈpeɪdʒɪz ˈleɪɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 蓋了騎縫章，之後就沒人能把頁抽換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Neat. Is notarizing free, or does it cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /nit ɪz ˈnoʊtəˌraɪzɪŋ fri ɔɹ dʌz ɪt kɔst/
dialogue.zh: 高明。公證是免費的，還是要收費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free for account holders, are you one?
dialogue.phonetic: /fri fɚ əˈkaʊnt ˈhoʊldɚz ɑɹ ju wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 對本行帳戶持有者是免費的，你們是嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are, she's had an account for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑɹ ʃiːz hæd əˈkaʊnt fɚ jɪɹz/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，她的帳戶都開了好幾年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it's free, nice perk of banking here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪts fri naɪs pɝk əv ˈbæŋkɪŋ hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那就免費，在這邊往來的一個小好處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, I never knew that perk existed.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ ˈnɛvɚ nu ðæt pɝk ɪɡˈzɪstɪd/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我以前都不知道有這種好處。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people don't, they pay ten bucks elsewhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl doʊnt ðeɪ peɪ tɛn bʌks ˌɛlsˈhwɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 多數人都不清楚，都在外面花十塊錢辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, today it costs us exactly nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl təˈdeɪ ɪt kɔsts ʌs ɪɡˈzæktli ˈnʌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那今天我們花的錢剛好是零。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here she comes, perfect timing, come on in.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ʃi kʌmz ˈpɝfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ kʌm ɑn ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 她來了，時機剛好，請進來坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mom, this is the notary, just sign here.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɑm ðɪs ɪz ðə ˈnoʊtəˌrɛɹi dʒʌst saɪn hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 媽，這位是公證人，就在這裡簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One thing first, ID, if you don't mind.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θɪŋ fɝst aɪˈdi ɪf ju doʊnt maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 先確認一件事，不好意思，請出示證件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All set, her license is current and valid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl sɛt hɚ ˈlaɪsəns ɪz ˈkɝɚənt ænd ˈvælɪd/
dialogue.zh: 都備好了，她的駕照還在效期內。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. Now sign the line, take your time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈnaʊ ˈsaɪn ðə ˈlaɪn ˈteɪk jɔɹ ˈtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 很好。現在請在簽名欄下筆，慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's done, um, now what, the stamp thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiːz dʌn ʌm ˈnaʊ ˈwʌt ðə ˈstæmp θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 她簽好了，嗯，接著呢，那個印章？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stamp thing is my favorite part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stæmp θɪŋ ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvɚɪt pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 那個印章環節正是我最愛的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, it does look like a video-game seal.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪt dʊz lʊk laɪk ə ˈvɪdiˌɡeɪm sil/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那顆章看起來像遊戲裡的封印。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Embossed, pressed, dated, and we're almost done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪmˈbɔst prɛst ˈdeɪɪd ænd wɪɹ ˈɔlmoʊst dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 壓紋、蓋印、填日期，就快搞定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was fast, honestly I expected all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wəz fæst ˈɑnəstli aɪ ɪkˈspɛktɪd ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好快，老實講我以為要耗上一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two minutes, three pages, all sealed and dated.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnəts θri ˈpeɪdʒɪz ɔl sil ænd ˈdeɪɪd/
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘，三頁，全部蓋好章註好日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need anything else for the school?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ˈniːd ˈɛnɪθɪŋ ɛls fɚ ðə skul/
dialogue.zh: 學校那邊還需要別的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, just hand them the original today.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp dʒʌst hænd ðɛm ði əˈɹɪdʒənəl təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不用了，今天把正本交出去就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if the school calls to check the seal?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ðə ˈskul ˈkɔlz tə ˈtʃɛk ðə ˈsil/
dialogue.zh: 要是學校打電話來核對印章呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They can call us, the number's on the stamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kæn kɔl ʌs ðə ˈnʌmbɚz ɑn ðə stæmp/
dialogue.zh: 他們可以直接打來，電話就刻在印章上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can we get a copy for our files?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt kən wi ɡɛt ə ˈkɑpi fɚ ɑɹ faɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我們可以留一份影本嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll scan it now, check your email tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl skæn ɪt naʊ tʃɛk jɔɹ ˈimeɪl təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我現在掃描一份，今晚傳到你們信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You made a scary errand feel tiny.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪd ə ˈskɛri ˈɛɹənd fil ˈtaɪni/
dialogue.zh: 你讓這趟嚇人的差事變得好小一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Notarizing is easy when folks ask first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtəˌraɪzɪŋ ɪz ˈizi wɛn folks æsk fɝst/
dialogue.zh: 只要事先問清楚，公證一點都不難。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lesson learned, never sign before the notary.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛsən lɝnd ˈnɛvɚ saɪn bɪˈfɔɹ ðə ˈnoʊtəˌrɛɹi/
dialogue.zh: 學到了，公證前千萬別簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell everyone, that mistake costs a reprint.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn ðæt mɪsˈteɪk kɔsts ə ˈriˌprɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 這可要跟親友說，這種錯誤得重新印一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for patience, and the free service.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɚ ˈpeɪʃənz ænd ðə fri ˈsɝvɪs/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你的耐心，還有這次免費的服務。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, enjoy the field trip talk at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪˌtaɪm ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðə ˈfild trɪp tɔk æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，回家好好聊畢業旅行吧。

script.youtube_title: 【銀行公證全流程🏦】「我是不是搞砸了」簽名蓋章一次聽懂🪪🖋️💸｜聽完自己也會辦｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Document Notarization
script.youtube_title_en: "Did I Ruin It?" — Getting a Document Notarized at the Bank
script.youtube_description:
「我是不是搞砸了」——好不容易把弟弟的畢業旅行文件帶到銀行，卻發現簽名早就在家裡寫好了，怎麼辦？這一集用 60 句連續對話，帶你走完美國銀行公證的完整流程。

你會聽到：詢問公證窗口與是否需要預約；得知簽名必須當著公證人的面完成；把媽媽叫進場前要準備的身份證明；名字與證件要怎麼對照；每頁蓋騎縫章的原因；本行客戶免費這個隱藏版好處；還有正本、影本與掃描檔怎麼分工。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與十分鐘內聽得懂的短句，重現在銀行櫃檯最真實的美式語感：um、well、so、ha、nope。聽完你就會用：Where can I find...、Do I need an appointment?、sign it in front of me、It's free for account holders。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Did I ruin it?" — the form was already signed at home, and the notary needs it fresh. This 60-line immersive listening practice walks you through a bank notarization from the waiting line to the final stamp.

You will hear: asking where the notary is, learning the signer must appear in person, the photo-ID requirement, matching names on documents, why every page gets sealed, and the free-notarization perk for account holders.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with real counter small talk: um, well, so, ha, nope. By the end you'll own phrases like Do I need an appointment?, sign it in front of me, and Can we get a copy for our files?.

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
弟弟要出遠門參加畢業旅行，學校說同意書得先公證。到了銀行你才想起來：媽媽在家就把名字簽好了，這樣算無效嗎？要帶什麼證件、收多少錢、會花多久？

這一集帶大家走進銀行公證窗口，從排隊詢問、當面重新簽名、核對駕照姓名，一路聽到騎縫章、正本影本與免費客戶禮遇，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🏦 找窗口：Hi, where can I find a notary?
🪪 證件句：A current photo ID, that's the main one.
🖋️ 關鍵規則：Here's the rule: she signs it in front of me.
💸 隱藏版好處：Free for account holders, are you one?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、nope 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著辦完這趟公證，下次手上有文件要蓋章，你就知道該先問哪幾句。

祝你的每份文件都準時完成。
